notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.permissionOff: Notifications are off for Family Hub on this device.
notifications.permissionOn: Notifications are on for this device.
notifications.webUnavailable: Notifications come to the phone app. Web notifications arrive in a later version.
notifications.list_changedHint: At most one per list every 10 minutes
notifications.quietHoursHint: Notifications arrive silently during these hours. “Where are you?” from an adult to a child always sounds.

location.explain: Share where you are with your family, so they can see you're safe and when you'll be home. Only your family sees it, and you can pause or stop at any time. Positions older than 24 hours are deleted.
location.explainAlways: To keep your family's map up to date when Family Hub is closed, choose “Always” on the next screen. Sharing uses little battery: it updates about every 100 m while you're moving and stops while you're still.
location.foregroundOnly: “Always” wasn't allowed, so your location is shared only while Family Hub is open. You can change this in your phone's settings.
location.permissionDenied: Location access is off for Family Hub. Turn it on in your phone's settings to share.
location.needsAdult: An adult in your family needs to allow location sharing for you first.
location.webUnavailable: Location sharing works in the phone app.
location.batteryHint: If your position stops updating on Android, turn off battery optimization for Family Hub in your phone's settings.

setup.notificationsBody: Get a heads-up when someone assigns you a task, before events start, and when your family asks where you are. You choose which ones in Settings.
setup.locationBody: Let your family see where you are on the map. It's off unless you turn it on, and you can pause any time.
setup.later: You can change these any time in Settings.
